Tax is excluded at 0%; enter an applicable rate if confirmed. Reserve is a planning allowance. Travel applies to each on-site service visit, even if visits might later be combined.

What is included in this planning estimate?

Base assumptions: accessible property, normal working hours and the selected scope only. Rates, minimums and condition adjustments are prototype assumptions, not verified Cyprus market prices or approved INONDA tariffs. Property type changes the planning checklist, not the rate.

Cleaning & gardening: routine labour and basic consumables assumed; specialist machinery, waste removal, tall trees and hazardous materials excluded. Cleaning area is capped to indoor size.

Renovation: the selected finish allowance and labour only. Structural changes, permits, surveys, major plumbing/electrical works, fixtures and unforeseen defects are excluded. A site survey and licensed professionals may be required.

Maintenance & handyman: inspection or labour allowance only; parts, repairs and specialist trades excluded. Management covers coordination and reporting only; third-party bills and rent collection are excluded.

Monthly cleaning or gardening uses the selected visit frequency. Weekly visits average 52 ÷ 12 per month. Monthly figures are ongoing costs; one-off work is separate. No duration or availability is promised.
